reviews.text:
Communication this time wasn’t great.
Original email not read by the nurse properly and ask a question that’s was put in the original email.
A great consultation that was not rushed and sympathetic.
A very positive experience at The Animal Clinic - Dr Julia was exceptionally professional, kind and helpful.
Friendly and professional vets and reception staff with reasonable costs make The Animal Clinic a good choice.
Lovely experience,everyone is so kind and welcoming,

I have been going to the Blackheath practice since my 11 year old rescues were kittens. They are always treated kindly and if they need treatment, options are discussed clearly, with the pet’s welfare and best solution at the forefront. Thoroughly recommend.
Absolutely brilliant. Highly recommend

We have been using vet practice ever since we got our dog charlie from battersea dogs home
They are fantastic and always so helpful
Kirsten especially is great
She managed to calm charlie down every time and being vip members we get 2 x free health checks and nail clips per year

This was our first time visiting the clinic with two cats, and it left a very positive impression.

The clinic is clean and welcoming, the staff are attentive, and a real bonus is the free car park, which makes visiting with pets so much easier.
Thank you for taking such good care of our little ones!
Great practice

My initial contact was excellent. A genuine telephone conversation with staff that was lovely. Dr Linda, reptile specialist was absolutely lovely and thorough. While I was very upset, she was reassuring with a course of treatment and instilled confidence. The cost was a shock as well; it was very reasonable and a lot cheaper than I've been charged. Will now register my other pet
Very friendly lovely staff, seen quickly and Vet was very helpful.
Great experience and follow up every year to remind me when it's time to boost my cat's vaccines. Very professionals

It was my first time at The Animal Clinic and I was naturally slightly anxious as was my 13 year old cat Oreo, however the vet and nurse went above and beyond to make sure that Oreo was as comfortable as possible, despite her clearly being very anxious. The checks were thorough and they even recommended a blood pressure check there a then due to an arrhythmia. I would recommend The Animal Clinic to anyone in the area looking for a friendly and caring vet.
My cat who is 19 had to have her claws trimmed,  she kicked off with a lot of sass but they dealt with her with  such professionalism and were so patient
Hi, Daniel. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
The service was very good the waiting area was very welcoming the staff was very friendly and the vet was very nice.

Boris is my adopted cat from Manchester and has been registered with the Animal Clinic since December 2022.  This clinic has been amazing and supported us with registration, appointments and queries.
Boris is now microchipped, immunised and gets his preventative meds regularly
I took Boris in a week ago as he had a rash on his belly and he kept licking it, making it worse.
Got an appointment quickly - reception staff offered me  a canceled appointment - and the consultation with the Vet offered us all options.  We followed the advice and now the rash is gone!
I am so happy to have you as my Vet, Animal clinic!
Last year I lost a cat and I had terrible trust issues with the previous vet since

You managed to restore this trust and just want to say Thank you for your professionalism, expertise and kindness.

Corina and Boris

The Animal Clinic is the best practice in the area. There are other vets closer to where I live but it's worth travelling for the quality of service The Animal Clinic provides. Outstanding staff (vets/nurses/receptionists), super friendly, empathetic and they're a pleasure to visit ... for me anyway!

We visited this clinic on 29 June. We read the positive reviews about this place and decided to make an appointment for our cats. When booking through their website, we clearly noted everything we wanted, including blood tests and vaccinations.

We arrived at the clinic on time for our appointment, actually 10–15 minutes before our scheduled appointment at 5:00 PM. However, the clinic was running late, and we were not taken into an examination room until after 5:30 PM. As soon as we entered the room, the veterinarian immediately told us that she was running late and that her shift had actually already ended. We really didn’t understand this. We had checked in 15 minutes before our appointment time. If the clinic was running late, that was obviously not our fault. Starting the appointment by complaining about how late she was felt extremely unprofessional.

We confirmed that we were there for blood tests and vaccinations. She then told us that we should not have booked the last appointment slot if we wanted blood tests and that we should have made the appointment by phone instead. Excuse me, but please check your appointment notes. We clearly wrote down everything we wanted, including the blood tests, when we booked the appointment online. If this is genuinely a concern for the clinic, then perhaps online booking should not be available, or at the very least, the appointment notes should be reviewed before confirming the booking. It is not reasonable to blame the client for information that we had already provided clearly when making the appointment.

She told us that cats can be difficult and that if they didn’t cooperate, they wouldn’t be able to take blood. She seemed very reluctant and uninterested throughout the appointment. She attempted to draw blood from both of our cats but unfortunately was unsuccessful. We understand that this can happen, and that itself is not the issue. However, her attitude and the way she spoke to us were unpleasant and unprofessional.

While shaving one of our cats’ necks in an attempt to take blood, she accidentally caught the cat’s skin with the clippers. Our cat became extremely frightened.

She also did not spend enough time on the general examination or properly address our concerns. When explaining the vaccinations, she seemed irritated and kept sighing. We also pointed out a small deposit/lump on the left side of one of our cat’s mammary area. She barely looked at it and simply said that it was dirt buildup. She then tried to clean it but couldn’t, and did not provide any further explanation or examination. She just told us to clean it at home. However, this was actually a deposit under the skin, not dirt.

Overall, this was a very disappointing experience. We will definitely not be returning. The veterinarian’s attitude was rude, dismissive, and unprofessional, and unfortunately we did not feel that our cats received the level of care or attention they deserved. We came to this clinic based on its positive reviews, but the experience was completely different from what we expected.
Kind, friendly service, glad I used them and will use them again. Thank you

UPDATE 5TH August: My new rescue  cat Holly had excellent treatment today at the Animal Clinic for her FAD which means her skin is extremely sensitive and she had itchy flare-ups.  Linda the vet is very kind and knowledgeable ( as is Nikky) . Helen on Reception is wonderful as are all the staff and vet nurses. This veterinary practice is first class!

Updated June 25th 2026- We adopted a new rescue cat today after needing  space to come to terms with the death of my previous cat- Lily- see below.

My new cat Holly - 13 yrs old- was checked by Nikki ( great vet) and the vet nurse Molly - thank you for helping by holding Holly when Nikki trimmed  Holly's nails ) and all of the team on the front desk - esp Helen- are great!

This vet practice is calm and welcoming for the human pet mum & dads and the pets- nothing is too much trouble. I am so glad we have signed Holly onto this Vet Surgery & the vet plan care package. We know Holly - see photo ) will be very well- looked &cared -for here  - hence 5 stars - thank you.

Updated 29th Dec 2025: My lovely cat Lily passed away today - we loved her dearly. All staff from the reception staff, the vet nurse and the vets ( Nicki and the person assisting Nicki) were kind, compassionate, caring and professional to me and Lily. Thank you to all staff at the Animal Clinic for your kindness at this very sad and difficult  time. May Lily rest in peace. Pam F.

Eight months ago : Cameron sorted my cat (Lily)  matted fur- she couldn't clean her back thigh due to arthritis- he shaved her and all is good now . I think Cameron is a new vet at this practice- very professional and kind vet- worth a try!

The first clinic I’ve been in London, I was afraid something was wrong with my cat but I was reassured and my cat received all the needs he needed. The staff is the friendliest, even if I was panicking, I knew my cat was in great environment and that’s all that mattered. I recommend 100%!

We have been bringing our dog here for years.

Professional, friendly and helpful staff. One of the best clinics around……

28th July 2026 - Called the practice at 8.30 as had a Spaniel with the dreaded head shake and ear scatch.

Booked an appointment and duly attended the surgery, unfortunately said Spaniel wouldn't cooperate so had to be sedated for the procedure to check ears and remove seed.

Sleepy Spaniel collected a couple of hours later.  All good.   Staff at the practice are great and I have confidence when taking my pets to visit.

First experiences with this vet Nikki was very good, but unfortunately I've been incredibly disappointed with follow ups with other staff, including communication and attitude. I'll be moving my two dogs and stop recommending.
Great professional service. Courteous and organised. Thank you
Fantastic service,  all the team look after my kitten perfectly

My first visit with my kitten was so smooth. They advised me on how to take care of him, were very honest, eased his vet anxiety, and even gave us a gift bag. I was honestly impressed by how kind all the staff were. Yes, they are professionals, but you can see how much they love animals.
A great experience.

Our doggie has significantly health issues, including IVDD disc disease and brain swelling. His movement and quality of life has been significantly impacted.  We are so grateful to all the vets who have helped and to Nikki, whose skilful acupuncture treatments have made a huge difference. He is walking with a swagger again, seems to be in far less pain and appears to be enjoying life again. Words are inadequate to describe how grateful we are. Thank you!

Dr Nikki is so very patient. My cat is horrible,  spitting and clawing. Dr Nikki gently spoke to her, got help to hold her, and carefully cut her nails. Yes, that's all that needed doing. Yet, my very objectionable cat won't let me do it, so I turn to the amazing Dr Nikki for help. Everyone in the vet surgery is lovely. We've used them for almost 15 years. I cannot recommend them highly enough.

the practice seems to rely on £75+ general consultations where very little is actually done. In my case, there was virtually no examination of my cat, which I can understand may be limited if the cat won't cooperate. However, what I cannot understand is why the consultation itself provided so little value.

If a physical examination isn't possible, I would expect the consultation to focus on explaining the procedure, likely costs, what is and isn't included, potential risks, possible outcomes, and the next steps. Instead, I left with none of that. There was no meaningful discussion or guidance—just the promise of an estimate by email.
it's not isolated case. doctor did not have meaningful conversation with me and just urged me to leave in 10 minutes into consultation which consisted of 30 second attempt to look into cat's mouth and 9 minutes of random remarks. no professional summary what to expect, risks and guidance.

I paid £75, put my cat through the stress of travelling and handling, and left with no useful assessment and no useful consultation. If the purpose of the appointment was to establish a plan and help me make an informed decision, it completely failed to achieve that.
A lovely, warm place. I would really recommend this for your pets. I took my Bearded Dragon there and the vet was excellent.
This is a consistently great vet practice in my experience, from the nurses to the veterinaries.
As soon as you walk in you get a friendly face in reception, whichever vet I’ve seen has always been positive in their approach and explained any problems in a way that is clear and concise
Kind, dedicated, and personal, so although my cat is very scared of going to the vet- he is treated like a family member by the vet team, and I am extremely happy to have found them.
The Animal Clinic in Blackheath : the team are professional, kind and friendly.
So happy with this vets, having used a few in the area. Friendly, each vet I've seen takes time to explain and in comparison to previous vets, reasonably priced.

We have used the Animal Clinic for 5 years and every time we visit Nelly goes in with a wagging tail. The staff all clearly love the animals they work with and always make us feel at ease. The VIP package they offer is great value for money and helps me with remembering to give Nelly her regular flea treatments. Would highly recommend to anyone.

The Vet had very skilfully removed grass seeds stuck deep inside my dog’s ear and relieved its pain. I am very happy about the experience of calling, obtaining the appointment, reception, treatment and the facilities at the clinic.
Always friendly and helpful. Always providing the best care for my pet. Great staff with caring customer service.
Really helpful. Warm and kind staff

I cannot recommend this veterinary practice highly enough.

I needed to arrange all of the paperwork and health checks for my cat to travel from London to China, and to be honest, the whole process initially felt incredibly overwhelming and far more complicated than I knew how to deal with. From my very first email, the team were patient, responsive, and genuinely helpful.

They guided me through every step of the process, answered all of my questions clearly, and made what seemed like a mountain of paperwork feel straightforward and manageable. They were incredibly thorough, checking and re-checking everything to make sure there would be no issues, which gave me a huge amount of confidence and peace of mind.

What really stood out was how caring and supportive they were throughout. They understood how stressful international pet travel can be and were always happy to explain things and offer reassurance. Every interaction, whether by email or in person, was professional, efficient, and friendly.

Thanks to their expertise and organisation, what could have been a very stressful experience became surprisingly easy. I am so grateful for all of their help and would not hesitate to use them again in the future. If you're looking for a vet you can trust, especially for international pet travel and export paperwork, I would wholeheartedly recommend them.

Thank you again for everything you did for me and Oban.

Really happy to have finally found a team of professionals who provide 1st class customer service, fair prices and take wonderful care of their patients. The gerbil is healthy and we are both very happy.
A big thank you to all the staff at the Animal Clinic for the care, help, advice and treatment for Bidi for over 16 years.
Very helpful and honest I’ll go there again

Excellent service! Provided us with the Animal Health Certificate and a rabies certificate to help us take our dog to France for a holiday and bring him back home! Very helpful and took away some  of the stress of travel.
Good experience and good value. Would recommend. Thank you Animal Clinic.
Always seen with compassion and kindness

Thank you for your review. We’re sorry to see that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We take all feedback seriously and would appreciate the opportunity to understand what went wrong and see if we can help. Please feel free to get in touch with us directly so we can look into this further. Thanks
Brilliant practice. Very caring. Would highly recommend. The reception staff are very welcoming and the vets first class.
Best vets in the area, I wouldn’t take my ferrets anywhere else now. The staff are lovely and love what they do, my ferrets are always well looked after here, highly recommend.
Able to get appointments at the weekend, close to home and not charged extortionate out of hours fees like some of the big companies of vets.

The staff here are so welcoming and supportive. They are helpful and understanding of situations and take the time to explain things carefully. The best comfort and support when it was time to say goodbye to our pup. Thank you!

I have been using the Animal Clinic for over three year's now.I have always found the receptionists very polite, friendly and accommodating

The Veterinarians are awesome;  when my Shih tzu became seriously ill in 2025, they referred us to their partner practice in Streatham Hill.

I cannot thank you guys enough for your caring, compassionate service we receive every visit.

Thank you all.
The vet, Nicki was amazing with Digby. As he was quite anxious and in pain. She calmed him and she explained everything clearly to me.
I'm very happy with the care we received from the Animal clinic. My cat Strawberry is in a very good hands. Thank you everyone! Xx
Great service, lovely knowledgeable vet and super friendly admin girls at reception! My puppy got lots of cuddles x
Always deal with a query promptly staff very helpful i really like this vets

Friendly professional staff, I was seen at my appointment time.  I moved to the Animal clinic because previously I was told my cat had to have a descale and potentially his teeth out at a cost of £1000.00, I moved to the Animal clinic as the costs seemed less exorbitant, at the check up today I was given some advice on how to manage the condition at home and to keep the condition under review - a nice change not to be upsold an expensive potentially un necessary procedure all in all impressed with the clinic and I have definitely made the right choice in changing vets

Fantastic Vets!  Have had our dog there a few times and they have looked after our Jack Russel very well.  From routine checks and vaccinations to little mishaps when he ate something he shouldn't.  They were friendly, affordable and most of all exceptionally caring towards animals.  Highly recommend!

I’ve been to many vet practices over the years, but when I began fostering a dog through a charity that uses the Shooters Hill Animal clinic, I transferred my pets over as well. They are absolutely amazing, really professional, caring and kind.

We recently moved to the area and was worried about a new vets as our previous one was not great but our first visit was a complete change to what we experienced before. Everyone was polite, caring and welcomed questions and concerns. I was so happy that the staff were not dismissive nor mis handle my dog. They were patient with him and gentle and it showed they cared about animals and not just getting as many people through the door as possible to make money. Very happy with the experience. I hope this continues.

Although I do not normally use this practice my own vet couldn't see me today and arranged for me to be seen at The Animal Clinic.  It was a very positive experience and the vet who treated my cat was very sympathetic and knowledgeable.  I have been to this practice many time with my friend's dog who is registered there and have been impressed with the treatment offered and particularly when our lovey friend was put to sleep.  They couldn't have bee kinder or more sympathetic.  Lovely practice.
Went for a second opinion appointment - ended up a customer. Lovely, kind staff who take time to notice the pets as well as the owners. I’d say this practice is something for other vets to aspire to.
Super helpful team! Take emergency well and  deeply care of my cats, everyone in the team showed 100% love and passion to animals. Professional consolation and suggestions. 100% recommended.
We have been going to the Animal Clinic at Shooters Hill for 15 years with our cat and found the vets and staff extremely helpful. I would recommend this clinic to all pet owners.

We had such a positive experience at Animal Clinic Blackheath when our dog Ted needed 7 teeth extracted. The team were incredibly kind, reassuring, and professional from start to finish. They explained everything clearly and took such great care of him – he’s recovering really well. Thank you for making a stressful situation so much easier. Highly recommend!

Brilliant vet clinic
Helpful sympathetic staff
Highly recommended
Great visit to the Animal Clinic excellent vet and receptionist would highly recommend.

I chose this clinic based on its positive reviews and recommendations from others, but my experience has been disappointing. I took my dog there twice, and during the first visit, the vet overlooked several important checks, such as examining their ears, paws, heartbeats, and eyes. On my second visit, I had to remind a different vet to check my dogs' ears as well. We decided that my dog needed surgery, and I requested dental work to avoid putting him under anesthesia twice. However, I was charged for anesthesia twice and had to ask the vet to correct it, which she acknowledged as a mistake. On the day of the surgery, I faced a 40-minute wait due to an emergency, which was concerning since my dog is older and gets anxious at the vet. It's frustrating that they couldn't accommodate my dog because of a shortage of available vets. They should have a plan of how to take dogs waiting foe surgery quickly so the dog gets minimal stress. Overall, I am not satisfied with the service I've received.

We were seen very promptly but I’ll be asking for a breakdown of costs before paying, in future. Very expensive appointment. I never agreed to giving a 50p charity donation, so it shouldn’t have been andded on without my consent - it’s very cheeky. And I didn’t realise doing some checks on my cat would incur additional charges.
Very friendly reception staff. Veterinary nurse very friendly. Great service, highly recommend, kitten had no issues or stress.
A very friendly clinic, the entire staff is very kind and friendly. Professional approach to my cat. I recommend it to everyone. May your pets be healthy.
The vet was very friendly and helpful as always. We didn’t have to wait for long. I liked the waiting area which was nice bright and spacious.
Lovely vets, nurses and reception staff. They have suggested cheaper options for expensive prescriptions and provide great alternative options such as accupuncture.

3rd trip to Animal clinic today for cats castration. I am still blown away with what an amazing vets this is. Today I didn’t get the vets name but it was the lady with pink hair and she was so knowledgable and attentive. Explained everything so thoroughly and spend lots of time making sure I was aware of the after care required following the operation. Was even available for a quick call when I got home to answer a question on keeping the cat collar on. I really think all the staff at this vet and the facility are absolutely wonderful. An absolute pleasure to know they are looking after my pet. They even seem like they really care and connect with the animals character. I’m so glad I found this vet practise. What peace of mind to know my pet will always have the best treatment possible and is well cared for and looked after when with them. THANK YOU!!!
Excellent care provided by the vet every time we visit - very happy with the way they treat and handle my cat. The nurses and reception staff are lovely. PS: This is still true years later!

We took our tortoise to vet's for a health check and to have it microchipped. The vet was kind and patient with us and answered all our questions as it was our first time. Very happy with the service we received.
Very friendly staff. Sensible prices
Very friendly and welcome staff

All the staff were so friendly and took the time to reassure me and listen to my concerns. They were so kind and gentle with my pup. Vet Catarina was very patient and explained everything in detail. The staff at this practice really do care. Thank you 😊 …

Absolutely the best vet I have ever been to and I've seen alot of different vets at different surgeries the lady vet i saw was Absolutely fantastic she actually listened to what I was saying and gave me plenty of options for my pet Rats condition and the reception was super helpful and the pricing is very reasonable
Very proficient and helpful

Our doggy daughter, Toffee, loved Nikki, always professional service, very kind and knowledgeable!
All staff very efficient, thank you for being there for our little one!

I would highly recommend this animal clinic !
The staff is professional & super friendly.
Hi, Inita. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

I can't express how happy I am with the service at The Animal Clinic. It’s a very professional veterinary practice where Yoshi is always treated with such kindness and expertise. The facility is spotless and feels like a truly safe space for our furry friends.
Hi, Tahia. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!

Lovely veterinary clinic the staff are so friendly and welcoming they make a great fuss of the dogs and the dogs love going as do we as we get great service and very sound advice.   I would have no hesitation recommending the clinic   It’s easy to park (private car park) which is unheard of in London and the clinic is spotlessly clean.  The receptionist is lovely the nurses are lovely and the vets are superb.

We’ve been taking our cats here for a couple of years now and every visit has been a great experience. We’re always greeted with a friendly face, which instantly puts us at ease. The vet we always see is Nicki, who we absolutely love — she’s kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares. She takes such wonderful care of our Liza, and we wouldn’t trust her with anyone else. Highly recommend!
An excellent vets. They staff are brilliant from the reception team to the vets. I'm very happy here!
Hi, Stefania. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Great staff and excellent service, let down by poor execution of the petplan service.  I have had continual problems getting drugs posted to me regularly and on-time.  The practice needs to sort this out.  Despite pushing and selling this service, the actual admin overhead for me is worse now than it was before!

I have revised my original review to reflect the continual problems with petplan and posting drugs.  If only this was sorted out, I would be happy - but I'm given a bigger headache than ever!
Very friendly Veterinary surgery. My boy is always looked after😊 …

We have been using for the surgery for years. The team are so helpful.

Our pet recently passed away and they sent us the loveliest card. We were very touched.

Highly recommend this vet for hamsters. Dr Linda has treated several of my hamsters, including performing surgery on one of them. She really listens to your concerns and treats your hamsters with respect.
Nothing but kindness and compassion on a very sad day.

Sadly not a great experience the 2 times we went there with our puppy.

We were looking forward to the clinic and happy to see all the great reviews.

Sadly the team seems a bit all over the place and made us wait for 30+mins from our original appointment time to then in the end give us a different clients dog booklet with their vaccination stamps in.

Our puppy got her weight taken and we were in communication about getting a de-worming treatment, for which the team told us it will be ready at our next visit with the same vet (2 weeks later).

When we arrived at the appointment we were taken care of by a nurse (not the vet we booked with) who told us that we can’t get the de-worming from her and who didn’t give us the vaccine stamps from that visit.

In total we’ve waited for almost 2 months to get that de-worming prescription for our puppy and never heard from the clinic.

When I emailed them that I bought our own treatment by a recommendation of a friend, they only replied that they will remove the request for us, not even an apology for taking so long and not getting back to us since that last visit.

I really do hope that there is something they will do about this and that we can return to the clinic with a better experience next time, but so far the communication has been very disappointing.
The veterinarian was very kind and patient during my cat examination and took time to answer all my questions, would definitely recommend 😺 …
Good experience overall
Very professional , friendly and approachable team.
As always, service was great and the team is fantastic. This time wasn’t my usual vey,  but the new one, was as good as Dr Linda. Plus Gus loves the vet clinic, so we always have a happy visit.
Fantastic service and staff, can't fault them
The service was good but the vet wasn’t that friendly as the other two I met before
Great vets emergency appointment given Xmas eve and test carried out same day Thank you
Lovely vet for both my cat and dog - all the staff are really lovely and welcoming too. Would absolutely recommend.
Very kind when I was so upset at the passing of my dog
Hi, Ercan. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Hi, Peter. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

We took our 6 month old cavapoo puppy in to be spayed this week. The team were lovely, helpful and very friendly as always. They took great care of our puppy and kept us informed. Such a great veterinarian practice and glad she is VIP member.

A warm and welcoming place. My beloved cat Whiskey, 18 years old and suddenly very poorly, turned out to be suffering from kidney failure. The vet and her assistant were tender  and sympathetic  to us both. My questions about different possibilities were answered patiently, and when it became apparent that the best option for Whiskey was for her to be euthanised there and then, it was done with extreme compassion and sensitivity. We were unrushed, I was allowed private time with her and access to a box of tissues. Their sympathy for my loss was comforting, and their observation that she had been fortunate to live such a long and healthy life, with no medical intervention also helped. I have had 5 cats across the decades and experienced 4 animal clinics. This has by far been the best of them. Thank you so much for making such a sad loss also  a  strangely special farewell.

I recently took my dog Benji for surgery, and I couldn’t be happier with the care he received.
Dr. Linda is incredibly skilled, gentle, and professional, Benji’s surgery went perfectly, and his recovery has been amazing.

The nurses were so sweet and caring, and the receptionist was just as kind and helpful.
Everyone made the whole experience calm and reassuring.

I’m genuinely very pleased with everything, and I would highly recommend Dr. Linda and the whole team to anyone who wants their pet to be treated with real care and expertise.

Thank you for taking such wonderful care of Benji. 🐾💛
Never have an issue with booking our cat in! Always seen promptly, and all of the vets & nurses are lovely!
I would highly recommend the Animal Clinic.  The staff are very friendly and efficient.  Their VIP Plan is a great way to pay for your pet's treatment.

Professional vets who have been taking very good care of my cat.
Highly recommended.

Our 9-year-old cat named Cersei recently started having discharge from her behind 2 weeks ago, which made me and my partner very anxious. I researched reliable vets in our area and found great feedback about the Animal Clinic, so I decided to book an appointment. I was lucky to get a same-day slot.

We met Dr. Cameron, who was detailed, calm, and reassuring about our cat’s condition. He explained that her symptoms is related to pyometra,  her uterus was infected and needed to be removed. He walked us through the procedure, costs, and after-care thoroughly. Helen, the receptionist, was empathetic and kind as well.

Around 1:40 PM, I received a call letting us know that the procedure went well and that we could pick up our cat in an hour. The nurse with the lovely pink hair carefully explained all the post-operation recovery steps.

The Animal Clinic is exceptional in their service—professional, compassionate, and truly commendable. We are very grateful for their care.
Helpful and friendly, as usual. Scout loves you all!
Hi, Yvonne. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Always on time. Professional, friendly & quick. Highly recommended

Nice clinic. Reception staff very friendly.
Doctor who attended my dog was a bit afraid of the dog.
Very helpful and knowledgable team, quick appointment after initial contact.

We’ve been customers for nearly three years and these guys are absolutely fantastic! We had both our male cats neutered there and I one hundred percent recommend their team! Also the receptionists are always very kind and welcoming xxx
I’m very happy with the clinic. The staff was caring, explained everything clearly, and made Milo feel comfortable. Great experience overall.
Incredible service. Super friendly team, go above and beyond to support animals

I recently took my sick kitten and I couldn't be any happier with the care we received! The doctor was absolutely wonderful - incredibly informative and took the time to explain everything clearly, putting us at ease during a stressful situation.

The whole team was very welcoming and made sure my kitten got the best care possible. I'm so grateful for their help and would highly recommend  to any pet owner needing a compassionate and professional vet .
Very helpful and friendly staff

The reception was exceptionally clean and nice smelling. I appreciated that the waiting area was divided by types of pets. The receptionist Polly was very nice. The vet (Linda I believe) explained everything calmly to me as a first time pet owner / vet visitor. They treated my scared kitten with lots and lots love and patience. Prices were reasonable and explained upfront. Very happy!

I went in expecting to pay 70.00 ended up paying 204.00. I wasnt informed of the price before they gave treatments, good job i had the money to pay. Also i wasnt informed of potential side effects of one of the treatments and was so worried when cat became unwell.
Great practice, friendly staff and were able to fit me in at short notice. Thanks

I can not recommend The Animal Clinic enough. They were absolutely fantastic with my bunny’s procedure ever so helpful and friendly. Betsy was well looked after and woke up from surgery very happy and was a great little fur patient as I was told by the vet.
Thank you so much for giving Betsy the best care. X
Hi, Bella. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Staff are always great with my dog

We've been with the Animal Clinic for a little over a year now. They are absolutely brilliant, looking after our two cats with professionalism, friendliness and empathy. They are very understanding when we worry about little things and have provided expert advice and referrals to other services when required.

I strongly recommend this vet clinic for your pets if you're looking for somewhere with fair prices, who listens to you and treats your pet like their own. Wish I could give more stars!

Having rescued a rabbit without any thought or knowledge on how to look after them, it was suggested that I visit Margit and the team at the Animal Clinic as they are 'Rabbit' friendly Veterinarians. I have not been disappointed.
After checking my first - Billy - and explaining what was required in looking after such a house bunny, jabs done, I took him home. Unbeknown to me, I thought rabbits enjoyed eating bear grass; they do not. Having realised something was terribly wrong with him - he was pushing his head on the door and lying on the floor, flaccid, I took him to Margit. We thought he was going to die. Miraculously after numerous injections and being told that he may not survive, we were both surprised that he did. You see, rabbits have a very poor digestive system and suffer from gut stasis. I didn't realise Bear Grass creates gas that builds up in the gut. The rabbit won't eat and if they don't eat, they die. That was in 2009. Since  then I have had numerous house buns and each one has been  cared for by Margit and her team: Mary, Riai,  I could go to at least four other vets in our area but prefer to travel to see Margit. She was patient, knowledgeable and understanding. She didn't treat you like an idiot if you don't know something and  her team are as professional and compassionate as she is.

2023 update : Since I wrote this, Margit has left the practice to go back to Austria to care for her ill mother. I was bereft. The Animal Clinic has gone through a transitional phase which - for me - was a form of grief. Clinical staff left and new staff came and went and to be honest it was upsetting. RVC Exotic Vets are hard to find as are good Veterinary nursing and reception staff. I had considered looking elsewhere but I had a relationship with the Animal Clinic that I didn't want to change and to be honest, I'm glad I did. Linda Timossi isn't Margit. She is Linda Timossi. Educated, thorough, funny and passionate about small mammals. She - like Margit - knows her stuff. No one likes change but this one is actually rather good.
